deploymentMethod.whyNotACliUpload: A `vercel --prod` upload sends the WORKING DIRECTORY, which carries the unexplained AGENTS.md delta, and has no .git — so next.config.ts's resolveGitSha() would have stamped the build 'unknown' and destroyed the identity proof.
deploymentMethod.whyNotPromotingThePreviewAsIs: NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL and NEXT_PUBLIC_API_BASE_URL exist for the PRODUCTION target only and are inlined at build time. The preview build therefore had no API origin and would have fallen back to http://localhost:4000. Promoting it unchanged would have pointed the production frontend at localhost. Redeploying with --target production rebuilds the same git source under the production environment.
